latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Maker Generation Generator — Generate Videos from Your Content.

- Instantly generate 1080p videos from text prompts or short clips using an AI-powered cloud backend.  
- Streamlined workflow: upload, describe the desired video, and download in 1–2 minutes (no editing timeline or export settings needed).
- Handles user authentication and session creation automatically (uses NEMO_TOKEN and cloud backend).
- Supports wide range of file formats (video, audio, images) and outputs (mp4, mov, jpg, gif, etc.).
- Built-in credit management, error handling, and workflow suggestions for common video generation use cases.
- Responsive to diverse user prompts: generate, edit, add BGM, export, check credits, upload, and more.
